verdict.rationale: Crossplane explicitly documents that its declarative APIs (built on the Kubernetes API) are designed to be acted on by 'humans, automation, and AI systems' and are 'explicit, auditable, and machine-readable', plus it ships an official CLI for programmatic interaction with Compositions and Packages. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of an AI agent actually driving Crossplane via this API, and no explicit API reference/schema docs cited beyond marketing claims.
